constitution.title: Монгол Улсын Үндсэн хууль (1992 оны 1 дүгээр сарын 13), 2019 болон 2023 оны нэмэлт, өөрчлөлтийн хамт
constitution.publisher: Хууль зүйн үндэсний хүрээлэн (legalinfo.mn, Эрх зүйн мэдээллийн нэгдсэн систем)
constitution.note: Consolidated text. Art. 21: the State Great Khural is unicameral with 126 members elected for four years by a mixed system, 78 by majority and 48 by proportional representation (2023 amendment); art. 25(1)(16) and art. 68(2): referendums; art. 30-31: the President is elected for one six-year term in a two-round direct election (2019 amendment); art. 39: the Prime Minister is appointed by the State Great Khural; art. 51: judges are appointed; art. 57: aimags and the capital, soums within aimags and bags within soums, districts within the capital and khoroos within districts; art. 59: Citizens' Representatives Khurals in aimags, the capital, soums and districts and Citizens' General Khurals in bags and khoroos, aimag and capital khurals elected for four years; art. 60: governors nominated by the khural and appointed by the Prime Minister or the higher governor.

constitution_1924.title: 1924 оны Монгол Улсын Үндсэн хууль
constitution_1924.publisher: Хууль зүйн үндэсний хүрээлэн (legalinfo.mn, Эрх зүйн мэдээллийн нэгдсэн систем)
constitution_1924.note: First constitution of the Mongolian People's Republic. Ch. 3: the State Great Khural of delegates of the aimags, cities, and the army, convened yearly, and the State Little Khural it elects.

constitution_1960.title: 1960 оны Монгол Улсын Үндсэн хууль (БНМАУ-ын Үндсэн хууль)
constitution_1960.publisher: Хууль зүйн үндэсний хүрээлэн (legalinfo.mn, Эрх зүйн мэдээллийн нэгдсэн систем)
constitution_1960.note: Third constitution, adopted 6 July 1960. Art. 4: khurals of people's deputies at every level are elected by universal, equal, direct, secret suffrage; arts. 15-16: one People's Great Khural deputy per 4,000 inhabitants, elected for three years; art. 57: aimag, city, soum, and khoroo khurals of people's deputies elected for two years; art. 74: the Supreme Court is elected by the People's Great Khural.

sgkh_law.title: Монгол Улсын Их Хурлын сонгуулийн тухай хууль (2019 оны 12 дугаар сарын 20), нэмэлт, өөрчлөлтийн хамт
sgkh_law.publisher: Хууль зүйн үндэсний хүрээлэн (legalinfo.mn, Эрх зүйн мэдээллийн нэгдсэн систем)
sgkh_law.note: Art. 4.2-4.3: 78 members by majority in constituencies (the candidates with the most votes, as many as the constituency's mandates) and 48 by party list in one nationwide constituency (art. 11.4); art. 9.1-9.2: the State Great Khural calls the regular election before 1 February and voting falls on a working day in the second half of June of the election year; art. 9.9-9.10: extraordinary elections and by-elections; art. 12.1: constituencies are set before 1 February; art. 30.1: a party nominates up to 78 constituency candidates and up to 48 list candidates.

pres_law.title: Монгол Улсын Ерөнхийлөгчийн сонгуулийн тухай хууль /Шинэчилсэн найруулга/ (2020 оны 12 дугаар сарын 24)

pres_law.note: Art. 4.2.1: the regular election every six years (Constitution art. 30(2)); art. 8.2: voting on a working day in the first half of June of the election year; art. 76: a second vote (дахин санал хураалт) when no candidate wins a majority.

pres_law_1993.title: Монгол Улсын Ерөнхийлөгчийн сонгуулийн хууль (1993); 2012 оны 12 дугаар сарын 21-ний хуулиар хүчингүй болсон

local_law.title: Аймаг, нийслэл, сум, дүүргийн иргэдийн Төлөөлөгчдийн Хурлын сонгуулийн тухай хууль (2020 оны 1 дүгээр сарын 30), нэмэлт, өөрчлөлтийн хамт

local_law.note: Art. 9.2: the regular local election falls on a working day in the first half of October of the election year; art. 12.1: each khural sets its constituencies before 1 May; art. 29.1: parties nominate up to the constituency's mandates; art. 73.2: the candidates with the most votes, as many as the constituency's mandates, are elected; art. 76: by-elections (нөхөн сонгууль) in the same constituency.

election_law_2015.note: The single election law for the State Great Khural, President, and local khurals used for the 2016 and 2017 elections and the 2016 local elections; its parts were repealed by the 2019 and 2020 laws.

referendum_law.title: Ард нийтийн санал асуулгын тухай хууль (2016 оны 2 дугаар сарын 05)

referendum_law.note: National referendums may be initiated by the President, the Government, or at least a third of State Great Khural members; a referendum is valid when a majority of eligible voters take part, and the question is decided by a majority of those voting. The General Election Commission organizes it.

atu_law.note: Art. 32: the Citizens' General Khural of each bag and khoroo is an assembly of every eligible resident that elects the chair of its sitting and nominates the bag or khoroo governor (32.8.4); art. 37: aimag khurals have 25 to 41 representatives, soum khurals 15 to 29, the capital khural 45, and district khurals 25 to 43, by population, from the 2024 regular election; art. 53.1: each khural elects its chair at its first sitting for four years; art. 56.5: governors are nominated by a majority vote of the khural or general khural.

classes.name: Монгол Улсын Ерөнхийлөгчийн сонгууль
classes.finest_note: Candidate votes by polling section (хэсгийн хороо) in the Commission's workbooks from 2013; national candidate totals for 1993 to 2009 in the NSO's election table
classes.note: Elected directly since 1993 (Constitution arts. 30-31). Until 2019 a four-year term, renewable once; since the 2019 amendment a single six-year term, first served by the President elected on 9 June 2021. Candidates are nominated by the parties seated in the State Great Khural. A candidate needs a majority of those voting in the first round, else the top two meet in a second vote (2017); the State Great Khural then recognizes the winner by law. The 1993 to 2009 elections were held under the 1993 presidential election law.

cadence.runoff_rule: A majority of those voting elects; otherwise the two leading candidates meet again.

cadence.locator: https://legalinfo.mn/mn/detail/16106891958781 (art. 4.2.1: "ЗУРГААН ЖИЛ ТУТАМ"; art. 8.2: "06 ДУГААР САРЫН ЭХНИЙ ХАГАСЫН АЛЬ НЭГ АЖЛЫН ӨДӨР")
cadence.runoff_rule: A majority of all who voted elects; otherwise the two leading candidates meet in a second vote, and if that fails a new election is held (Constitution art. 31(4)-(5); law art. 76).
cadence.vacancy_rule: The Chair of the State Great Khural acts as President until a new President is elected (Constitution art. 34).

classes.finest_note: Polling-section results for 2024 (13 constituencies and the national list) in the Commission's workbooks; constituency candidate totals for 2020; seats by party for every election from 1992 in the NSO's election table
classes.note: Unicameral, elected for four years (Constitution art. 21). Systems: 76 seats by block vote in 26 multi-member constituencies (1992, 2008); 76 single-member constituencies with a 25 percent threshold (1996, 2000, 2004, 2016); 48 seats in 26 multi-member constituencies plus 28 by national party list (2012); 76 seats in 29 multi-member constituencies (2020); since the 2023 amendment 126 seats, 78 by block vote in 13 multi-member constituencies and 48 by national party list (2024). An early election follows self-dissolution or a failure to appoint a Prime Minister (Constitution arts. 22 and 33).

cadence.vacancy_rule: A by-election is called by the State Great Khural in the vacated constituency (art. 9.10); no by-election in the final year of the term.

dates.quote: СУМ, ДҮҮРГИЙН ИРГЭДИЙН ТӨЛӨӨЛӨГЧДИЙН ХУРЛЫН БҮРЭН ЭРХИЙН ХУГАЦАА 2 ЖИЛ БОЛСОНТОЙ ХОЛБОГДУУЛАН СУМ, ДҮҮРГИЙН ИРГЭДИЙН ТӨЛӨӨЛӨГЧДИЙН ХУРЛЫН ТӨЛӨӨЛӨГЧ СОНГОХ
dates.note: Soum and district khurals served two-year terms until 1996.

dates.quote: Иргэдийн төлөөлөгчдийн хурал, 1996: санал өгсөн 765.4 мянган хүн, оролцоо 72.1%
Иргэдийн төлөөлөгчдийн хурал, 2000: санал өгсөн 728.8 мянган хүн, оролцоо 65.9%
Иргэдийн төлөөлөгчдийн хурал, 2004: санал өгсөн 732.2 мянган хүн, оролцоо 67.2%
ОРОН НУТГИЙН ХУРЛЫН ЭЭЛЖИТ СОНГУУЛИЙГ 2008 ОНЫ 10 ДУГААР САРЫН 12-НЫ ӨДРИЙН НЯМ ГАРИГТ ЯВУУЛАХААР
АЙМАГ, СУМ, ДҮҮРГИЙН ИРГЭДИЙН ТӨЛӨӨЛӨГЧДИЙН ХУРЛЫН 2012 ОНЫ ЭЭЛЖИТ СОНГУУЛЬ
dates.note: Held in October 2012; NSO turnout table: 979.8 thousand voted, 52.9%.

dates.quote: СУМ, ДҮҮРГИЙН ИРГЭДИЙН ТӨЛӨӨЛӨГЧДИЙН ХУРЛЫН ЭЭЛЖИТ СОНГУУЛИЙН САНАЛ АВАХ ӨДРИЙГ 2016 ОНЫ 10 ДУГААР САРЫН 19-НИЙ ӨДӨР БАЙХААР ТОГТООСУГАЙ
dates.note: Soum and district khurals voted separately from the aimag and capital khurals; NSO turnout table: 1161.1 thousand voted, 60.4%.

dates.quote: ИРГЭДИЙН ТӨЛӨӨЛӨГЧДИЙН ХУРЛЫН ЭЭЛЖИТ СОНГУУЛИЙН САНАЛ АВАХ ӨДРИЙГ 2020 ОНЫ 10 ДУГААР САРЫН 15-НЫ ӨДӨР БАЙХААР ТОГТООСУГАЙ
Иргэдийн төлөөлөгчдийн хурал, 2024: санал өгсөн 1124.1 мянган хүн, оролцоо 50.0%
dates.note: Held on 11 October 2024, as dated in the Commission's workbooks.
By-elections (нөхөн сонгууль) in vacated council constituencies and a supplementary vote four days later; their split between aimag, capital, soum, and district khurals is not yet counted.

classes.name: Ард нийтийн санал асуулга
classes.note: The Constitution lets the State Great Khural call a referendum (art. 25(1)(16)), including on constitutional amendments by a two-thirds vote (art. 68(2)); the 2016 law requires a majority of voters to take part. No national referendum has been held under the 1992 Constitution. The only national vote of this kind is the independence plebiscite of 20 October 1945, held by the Mongolian People's Republic.
classes.disposition_reason: Nothing has been held since 1992; the only vote, the 1945 independence plebiscite, has no official result publication online.

dates.note: Independence plebiscite of the Mongolian People's Republic; no official publication online.

classes.name: Ардын Их Хурал, Улсын Бага Хурлын 1990 оны сонгууль
classes.name_en: People's Great Khural and State Little Khural, the multiparty elections of 1990 (abolished)
classes.note: The first multiparty election, on 29 July 1990 with later rounds, filled the 430-seat People's Great Khural from constituencies and the 50-seat State Little Khural, its standing body, by party vote. Both were replaced by the State Great Khural elected in June 1992.
classes.disposition_reason: No official publication of the 1990 results by constituency is online; the Commission's portal starts in 2013 and the NSO's election tables in 1992.

dates.note: First round; constituency and seat counts await an official source.

classes.name: Улсын Их Хурал, Ардын Их Хурал (1924-1986)
classes.name_en: State Great Khural (1924-1949) and People's Great Khural (1951-1986) of the Mongolian People's Republic (abolished)
classes.note: Under the 1924 Constitution, delegates of the aimags, cities, and army formed the State Great Khural, which elected the State Little Khural; under the 1960 Constitution the People's Great Khural was elected directly for three years, one deputy per 4,000 inhabitants, from a single list of candidates.
classes.disposition_reason: Single-list elections with no official result publication online.

dates.note: Khurals of 1924 to 1986; dates and counts await an official listing.

classes.name: Ардын депутатуудын аймаг, хот, сум, хорооны хурал (1990 он хүртэл)
classes.name_en: Aimag, city, soum, and khoroo khurals of people's deputies of the Mongolian People's Republic (abolished)
classes.note: Elected for two years by direct vote under the 1960 Constitution (art. 57), from single lists until the multiparty local elections of 1990; replaced by the Citizens' Representatives Khurals in 1992.

classes.name: Ерөнхий сайдыг томилох
classes.name_en: Prime Minister, appointed by the State Great Khural
classes.note: The State Great Khural appoints the Prime Minister on the nomination of the majority party or, failing that, of a coalition (Constitution art. 39).
classes.disposition_reason: Appointed by a vote of the State Great Khural, not by the electorate.

classes.name: Хурлын даргыг сонгох
classes.name_en: Chairs of the State Great Khural and of the Citizens' Representatives Khurals, elected by their members
classes.note: The State Great Khural elects its Chair from its members; each aimag, capital, soum, and district khural elects its chair at its first sitting for four years (ATU law art. 53.1).
classes.disposition_reason: Elected by the members of each khural, not by the electorate.

classes.name: Засаг дарга
classes.name_en: Governors of aimags, the capital, soums, districts, bags, and khoroos
classes.note: Each governor is nominated by the khural of the unit (the general khural in a bag or khoroo) and appointed for four years: aimag and capital governors by the Prime Minister, soum and district governors by the aimag or capital governor, bag and khoroo governors by the soum or district governor (Constitution art. 60; ATU law art. 56.5). The capital's governor is also Mayor of Ulaanbaatar.
classes.disposition_reason: Nominated by a vote of the khural or general khural and appointed by the Prime Minister or the higher governor, so no public ballot elects them.

classes.name: Баг, хорооны иргэдийн нийтийн хурал
classes.name_en: Citizens' General Khurals of bags and khoroos
classes.note: Every eligible resident may attend and vote; the assembly elects the chair of its sitting and nominates the bag or khoroo governor (ATU law arts. 32.3-32.8).
classes.disposition_reason: Open assemblies of residents that decide by show of votes at a sitting; no ballot is counted or published.

classes.name: Зөвлөлдөх санал асуулга
classes.note: Required before amending the Constitution under the 2017 law.
classes.disposition_reason: A consultation of a random sample of citizens run by the State Great Khural's or a khural's secretariat, not a vote of the electorate (the first was held on 29-30 April 2017 on constitutional amendments).

classes.name: Шүүгч томилох
classes.name_en: Judges and members of the Constitutional Court
classes.disposition_reason: Judges are appointed by the President on the proposal of the Judicial General Council, and the nine members of the Constitutional Court are named by the State Great Khural, the President, and the Supreme Court; none is elected by the public.

classes.name: Нам, эвслийн нэр дэвшүүлэлт
classes.note: A party or coalition nominates up to 78 constituency and 48 list candidates by decision of its own governing meeting (SGKh election law arts. 30-32); local nominations work the same way (local law art. 29).
classes.disposition_reason: Parties and coalitions choose their candidates at their own meetings; the State runs no primary.
